name: website_https
description: An Ansible playbook that installs Apache on Ubuntu, configures HTTPS with a self-signed certificate, deploys a Hello World virtual host and static content, and manages related services.

name: poodle_fix
description: An Ansible hardening playbook that disables insecure Apache SSL protocols while retaining TLS 1.2 and restarts affected services when configuration changes.

name: chef_platform_bootstrap_automate
description: Bootstraps Chef Automate and Chef Infra Server, then provisions a Chef user and organization with generated PEM credentials.

name: chef_platform_bootstrap_infra_server
description: Bootstraps Chef Infra Server, including host tuning, CLI setup, user and organization provisioning, and PEM credential generation.

name: website_https_compliance
description: Provides Chef InSpec compliance checks for HTTPS availability, expected website content, SSLv3 disablement, and TLS 1.2 support.

name: ssh_root_login_compliance
description: Provides a Chef InSpec control that verifies SSH root login is disabled, with a fallback for systems without the OpenSSH server package.
